title: Kissed Rich Ethiopian Gouda Cheese Casserole
description: A rich and festive Ethiopian dish featuring Gouda cheese, this casserole is perfect for special occasions and can be made vegan-friendly by substituting the cheese with a vegan alternative.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion mixture, shredded Gouda cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the torn injera bread to the bowl and stir until the bread is well coated with the cheese mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
